newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel to delist Powerfin post-merger.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel to delist Powerfin post-merger.

text.p: Belgian utility Tractebel said on Tuesday it planned to delist its Powerfin unit after the competion of the merger between the two groups later this spring.

Tractebel said earlier it was planning to merge with Powerfin, offering one new Tractebel share for three Powerfin shares. Tractebel currently has about 60 percent of Powerfin, its international energy unit.
Tractebel is a unit of Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB), itself a unit of French Cie de Suez.

Tractebel chief executive officer Philippe Bodson told a news conference the ratio had been obtained on the basis of share price and intrinsic value and confirmed by the criteria of earnings per share and dividend per share.
Bodson declined to specify the intrinsic value of Powerfin, but said the intrinsic value of Tractebel, at 16,500 to 17,500 francs, was well above its current market price of 14,800.
"I think the risk is small that we will meet any resistance against this ratio from Powerfin minority shareholders. It will be up to them to prove that we wanted to leser them," he said.

Tractebel had booked a 1.6 billion franc general provision for risks related to investments abroad. "We have purposely chosen to book this provision in Tractebel's accounts rather than in Powerfin's accounts to avoid accusations of presenting Powerfin in a bad light."
Bodson said that the offer had been reviewed by London-based Securities and Petercam Securities. "These group established the ratio was fair for Powerfin and Tractebel shareholders."
Tractebel and Powerfin boards are to approve special reports to shareholders about the merger on April 15. Final clearance must come from annual and extraordinary meetings in May.
